title: Roborock Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roborock:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day roborock metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on roborock metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your roborock metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
